name: Resource Lifecycle Request Completed
description: Sent to a requester to notify that their resource lifecycle request has been completed successfully.
subject: $data.sourceName – $data.operationType request completed successfully for $data.machineIdentityName
body:
Resource Lifecycle Request Completed

Hello $data.requesterName,

Your resource lifecycle request was completed successfully. A summary of the completed request is provided below.

Requested action: $data.operationType.toLowerCase()

Resource: $data.machineIdentitySubtype.toLowerCase() $data.machineIdentityName

Source: $data.sourceName

Thank you for using $__global.productName.
